trust_decision.summary: Whether unauthenticated Auphonic webhook POST data may be persisted to the Podlove log, decided in Auphonic::auphonic_webhook (the failure log ran before the authkey check), and whether stored log message/context is trusted as HTML when the Support page renders it, decided in Logging::dashoard_template (raw echo / print_r).

landing_point.why: The summary names the Auphonic webhook; this is the unauthenticated branch that logs the whole $_POST before any authkey check.

fix_sites.entry_point: Unauthenticated front-end request with ?podlove-auphonic-production=<id> (hooked on 'wp', lib/modules/auphonic/auphonic.php:44); fix validates post_id, moves the authkey check (hash_equals, is_string) ahead of failure logging
Same webhook; new failure_log_context() limits logged context to post_id plus sanitised string status_string/uuid
Podlove > Support page footer, admin only (podlove_support_page_footer, lib/modules/logging/logging.php:29-31); level class, date, message
Same Support page; context fields media_file link/slug, error, episode link/title, http_code, mime types, twig template/line
Same Support page; 'toggle details' <pre> blocks (print_r of extra context, raw JSON context fallback)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/modules/logging/logging.php:212-272 (the stored-log renderer in the separate logging module, fed by WPDBHandler persistence at lib/modules/logging/wpdbhandler.php:18-27)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once the webhook authenticates and logs only post_id/status/uuid, the Support page looks admin-only, showing 'internal' log data that only trusted code writes, so escaping it looks like a separate hardening task in a different module.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The Support log must keep rendering working <a href> links to the episode edit screen (media_file and episode_id context), the log-level-NNN class the JS filter keys on, and the toggle-details block. Escaping the whole sprintf output breaks the links. On the webhook side, a valid authkey with status 'Done' must still update production data and publish, and an authenticated failure must still log post_id/status_string/uuid.

O7_producer.where: lib/modules/logging/wpdbhandler.php:23-24 (message only esc_sql'd, context wp_json_encode'd, stored as-is; logging.php:223 json_decodes it back)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: AJAX handler with no capability or nonce check (wp_ajax_, any logged-in user) logs request-controlled post_id/authkey/flag into the same log at debug level
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already exists and reaches the same renderer. A copy at info level, or one logging raw $_REQUEST, is the kind of debug logging a maintainer adds, and it tests whether the solver fixed the renderer and not only the webhook.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: remote URL, error message and full response ('debug') logged into context
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Logging remote error bodies is ordinary diagnostics. A planted field (e.g. 'body' or 'reason') echoed in a new renderer branch next to http_code would be a realistic how-type sibling.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Auphonic API response body logged as context
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Third-party response content enters the log, so a renderer branch that pretty-prints 'body' or 'response' fits the existing pattern at logging.php:233-248.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an extra special-cased context key (e.g. data->url as a link) rendered in an href attribute context
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The renderer already special-cases keys and builds links. An attribute/URL-context field needs esc_url rather than esc_html, which is a how-type differential.

O9_family: Stored XSS (CWE-79) via unauthenticated write to an admin-rendered log, plus missing authentication ordering on the webhook

O10_build.toolchain: PHP ^8.0 (platform 8.0.29) + composer, phpunit ^9.6 + yoast/phpunit-polyfills, WordPress test suite
O10_build.project_tests: tests/phpunit/integration (no logging or Auphonic webhook test at the pinned commit; similar rendering-security tests such as tests/phpunit/integration/ShownotesStoredXssTest.php exist); fix diff adds no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Move the authkey check above the failure log in auphonic_webhook (or sanitize $_POST there) and leave the Support page renderer unescaped, so other writers (wp_ajax handler, curl/Auphonic response logging) still reach it.
